title: "GitHub App" is GitHub's product name for an app installed on repositories: keep it.
intro: Coding sessions are AI coding agents' sessions. "Coding → Repositories" names a settings page: keep it matching the Settings nav.
repository: Label of the text field where an admin enters the GitHub repository (owner/name) whose owner the GitHub App is made for.
repositoryPlaceholder: Format hint in an empty field: a GitHub repository as owner/name. Keep the slash; you may translate the two words.
repositoryInvalid: "owner/name" and "acme/app" show the format: keep the slash.
ownerFrom: Toast after saving: {{repository}} is the repository, such as acme/app.
repositoryCleared: Toast after the repository field was emptied and saved.
useDefault: Button: use the repository the server's environment sets instead.
usingDefault: Toast after the "Use the server’s default" button: the repository now comes from the server’s configuration.
saveFailed: Error on the GitHub App card when saving the repository failed. "Retry": try again.
status.unreadable: {{name}} is the GitHub App's short name or number; {{account}} the GitHub account or organization it is installed on. The _env forms add that the App comes from the server's environment (GITHUB_APP_ID, an environment variable). "Disconnect" and "Connect GitHub" are this card's buttons: keep them matching.
status.connected: Status line on the GitHub App card. {{name}} is the GitHub App’s short name or number. The _env form adds that the App comes from the server’s environment (GITHUB_APP_ID is an environment variable name: keep it).
status.installed: Status line: the GitHub App is connected and installed. {{name}} is the App’s short name or number; the _env form says it comes from the server’s environment.
status.installedOn: Status line: {{name}} is the GitHub App’s short name or number; {{account}} the GitHub account or organization it is installed on. The _env form says the App comes from the server’s environment.
explain: "Create" and "Install" are buttons on GitHub's own pages, in English. Coding agents are AI agents that write code.
needsOrigin: APP_ORIGIN is an environment variable name: keep it.
connect: Button on the GitHub App card: starts making and connecting a GitHub App, on GitHub’s own pages.
connectAgain: Button shown instead of "Connect GitHub" when an App is already connected: makes and connects a new one.
disconnect: Button on the GitHub App card: forgets the connected GitHub App in this workspace (it still exists on GitHub).
disconnectNote: "Developer settings → GitHub Apps" names GitHub's own settings pages, in English.
connected: Toast after coming back from GitHub with the App connected.
disconnected: Toast after Disconnect: the App is forgotten here but still exists on GitHub.
disconnectFailed: Error on the GitHub App card when Disconnect failed. "Retry": try again.
